cohort: The study included 20,914 hospital admissions for Caesarean section surgery in New Brunswick, Canada, between April 2004 and March 2014.
finding: The likelihood of post-Caesarean section complications was negatively associated with provider volume and experience, and positively associated with having a non-obstetrics/maternal-fetal medicine specialization.
mod_finding: Physician training and experience are associated with the likelihood of maternal complications following Caesarean section.
